definitions.explanation: A person who has been formally charged with a crime and is standing trial. A legal term used specifically in criminal proceedings.

examples.japanese: {被告人|ひこくにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}した→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。
⟦{裁判長|さいばんちょう}→裁判長：09666_saibanchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{被告人|ひこくにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}した→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧。
examples.english: The presiding judge questioned the defendant.

examples.japanese: {被告人|ひこくにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黙秘権|もくひけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant is guaranteed the right to remain silent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧ (accused) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). A formal legal term used in criminal trials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被告人|ひこくにん}⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: examination of the defendant
- {被告人|ひこくにん}⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: defendant's seat (in court)
- {被告人|ひこくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧: rights of the accused
- {被告人|ひこくにん}{尋問|じんもん}: interrogation of the defendant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧: defendant — used in both criminal and civil cases; in civil cases, this is the standard term
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: suspect — someone suspected of a crime but not yet formally charged
- ⟦{被疑者|ひぎしゃ}→被疑者：22237_higisha⟧: suspect (legal term) — formal/legal equivalent of ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧
- ⟦{原告|げんこく}→原告：11085_genkoku⟧: plaintiff — the opposing party; the one bringing the case

USAGE:
{被告人|ひこくにん} is specifically a criminal law term. In civil cases, the equivalent term is ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧ (without ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧). In Japanese news media, a person's name is often followed by ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧ (e.g., ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧) once they have been formally charged.
